Hunterbrook: Nebius’ $NBIS Vineland data center has received its second stop-construction order this week over permit issues. The first, on Aug. 6, halted LNG tank work. The second, on Aug. 10, halted Bloom Energy $BE fuel-cell work after the city said required approvals and permits had not been obtained. DataOne says the pause is temporary and should not affect the project timeline.

$NBIS on the Vineland, NJ site and the switch to $BE: "The amendment to the site layout plan was a result of the decision to switch the project's power source to Bloom. The switch to Bloom significantly enhances the project... It's an on-site power solution, delivering reliable power quietly and with ultra-low emissions." Baird upgrades First Solar $FSLR to Outperform, raises PT to $318 from $205. Baird cites a strong utility-scale solar market, removal of the Section 232 overhang, better-calibrated estimates, and potential clarity on capital allocation. The firm says the 232 resolution should help restart bookings for 2029-2030, potentially at higher ASPs.
